create_unified_file_id: create a unified file ID from provider file objects for multi-model file management
store_managed_file: store a LiteLLM managed file with model mappings in cache and database
check_file_access: check if a user has access to a managed file ID before processing a request
get_model_file_mapping: get model-specific file IDs for a list of unified file IDs from cache or database
delete_managed_file: delete a managed file from all models and remove from cache and database
